tasks.issue_text: A pre-0.5 configuration can contain both legacy vector_store path fields and new Qdrant fields, plus the old singular embedding block. Upgrades currently reject or lose that configuration. Migrate mixed legacy/new shapes without discarding the user's new provider, collection, or embedding selection.

Registry client 404 handling confuses a missing API endpoint with a missing pack and can lose the requested pack name when the server returns only a query-based 404. Classify HTML API-endpoint 404s as unreachable and preserve the query pack name for ordinary pack-not-found responses.

list and inspect surface a raw RuntimeError/traceback when another process owns embedded Qdrant, while doctor silently loses useful status. Convert only the known embedded lock conflict into clear CLI behavior without masking unrelated RuntimeError failures.

SQLite FTS returns no context when a natural-language multi-term query cannot satisfy the implicit AND match even though relevant sections contain subsets of the terms. Keep the normal phrase query, but add a bounded OR-token fallback when it returns no rows.

Sitemap indexes can recursively fetch too many child entries and can follow child sitemap URLs outside the documentation scope. Bound parsed entries by max_pages/max_entries and skip out-of-scope sitemap children while preserving normal sitemap traversal.

The SQLite-era default query budget is still 1200 tokens even though the intended retrieval default is 2400. Raise only the configuration default while preserving explicitly configured budgets and validation.

Embedding batch_size accepts zero or negative values, which makes the new batching path invalid at runtime. Add a positive lower bound to the configuration schema without changing unrelated embedding settings.

Users paste registry web-page URLs into pull, but pack-reference parsing only understands name or name@version. Normalize https registry page URLs, including an optional version query parameter, before the existing pack-reference split logic.
